title: The Rightly Guided Caliphs
description: Study the lives of the four Rightly Guided Caliphs (Khulafa ar-Rashidun): Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, and Ali (may Allah be pleased with them all). This course covers their leadership, justice, and the establishment of the Islamic state after the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).
short_description: Learn about the four Rightly Guided Caliphs and their leadership

modules.title: Abu Bakr as-Siddiq (May Allah Be Pleased With Him)
modules.description: This module covers the life and leadership of Abu Bakr as-Siddiq (may Allah be pleased with him), the first Rightly Guided Caliph, his role as the Prophet's closest companion, and his handling of the apostasy wars.

lessons.title: The Life of Abu Bakr as-Siddiq
lessons.content: The early life, character, and virtues of Abu Bakr as-Siddiq (may Allah be pleased with him), his acceptance of Islam, his devotion to the Prophet (peace be upon him), and his famous title 'As-Siddiq' (the Truthful).

lessons.title: The Caliphate of Abu Bakr
lessons.content: Abu Bakr's (may Allah be pleased with him) leadership after the Prophet's death, his handling of the apostasy wars (Ridda Wars), his compilation of the Qur'an, and his justice as the first Caliph.

lessons.title: The Death and Legacy of Abu Bakr
lessons.content: The final days and death of Abu Bakr as-Siddiq (may Allah be pleased with him), his nomination of Umar ibn al-Khattab as his successor, and his lasting legacy in Islamic history.

modules.title: Umar ibn al-Khattab (May Allah Be Pleased With Him)
modules.description: This module covers the life and leadership of Umar ibn al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him), the second Rightly Guided Caliph, known for his justice and the expansion of the Islamic state.

lessons.title: The Life of Umar ibn al-Khattab
lessons.content: The early life, conversion to Islam, and character of Umar ibn al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him), known for his strength, justice, and his famous title 'Al-Faruq' (the one who distinguishes between right and wrong).

lessons.title: The Caliphate of Umar
lessons.content: Umar's (may Allah be pleased with him) leadership, his system of governance, the expansion of the Islamic state, his justice system, and his famous patrol of the city at night to check on his subjects.

modules.title: Uthman ibn Affan (May Allah Be Pleased With Him)
modules.description: This module covers the life and leadership of Uthman ibn Affan (may Allah be pleased with him), the third Rightly Guided Caliph, known for his generosity and the compilation of the Qur'an.

lessons.title: The Life of Uthman ibn Affan
lessons.content: The early life, conversion to Islam, and character of Uthman ibn Affan (may Allah be pleased with him), known for his generosity, his marriage to the Prophet's daughters, and his famous title 'Dhun-Nurayn' (possessor of two lights).

lessons.title: The Caliphate of Uthman
lessons.content: Uthman's (may Allah be pleased with him) leadership, his compilation and distribution of the standard Qur'an text, the expansion of the Islamic state, and the fitna (tribulation) that arose during his caliphate.

modules.title: Ali ibn Abi Talib (May Allah Be Pleased With Him)
modules.description: This module covers the life and leadership of Ali ibn Abi Talib (may Allah be pleased with him), the fourth Rightly Guided Caliph, known for his knowledge, bravery, and wisdom.

lessons.title: The Life of Ali ibn Abi Talib
lessons.content: The early life, conversion to Islam, and character of Ali ibn Abi Talib (may Allah be pleased with him), the Prophet's cousin and son-in-law, known for his knowledge, bravery, and his famous title 'Asadullah' (the Lion of Allah).

lessons.title: The Caliphate of Ali
lessons.content: Ali's (may Allah be pleased with him) leadership, the civil wars (Fitna) during his caliphate, the Battle of the Camel, the Battle of Siffin, and his wisdom and patience in dealing with tribulations.
